summary: New Regatta-only Stoat AI tuning (Resources/AIBoostPolicies/StoatSlingConfig_Regatta, a copy of StoatSlingConfig with aiWarpMinDistance 400): the trampoline autopilot now also presses for the warp on long straights, as the Slingshot variant already does (310).
why: On Regatta's race line the steering target sits dead ahead, so the 35-degree turn rule never fired and the Stoat AI crawled at 60 u/s (239 s alone at I1). Real-game judge: 250 -> 64 s, 310 -> 63 s, 400 -> 53 s, 500 -> 51 s, 600 -> 82 s.
